Senior Director, Digital Marketing – Hearing Aids

Do you want to shape the future of digital marketing in a global hearing healthcare business and turn digital capabilities into measurable commercial impact?

Demant develops and produces cutting-edge, high-quality hearing aids with focus on helping people with hearing loss to get a better quality of life all over the world.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Director, Digital Marketing, to lead our global Digital Marketing organization within Hearing Aids.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of digital marketing in a global hearing healthcare business, lead a talented international team and make a visible contribution to customer engagement and commercial growth.

Your role

You will lead an international team of approximately 30 digital marketing specialists based in Smørum and Warsaw, with expertise spanning demand generation, marketing automation, digital activation, web excellence, performance marketing and digital projects.

Working closely with Brand Management, Sales, markets and other global functions, you will strengthen digital marketing as an integrated driver of commercial execution and growth.

You will set the direction for Digital Marketing and translate business and brand ambitions into scalable, customer-centric digital execution.

You will:

• Lead and develop the global Digital Marketing organization, building strong capabilities, collaboration and accountability.

• Drive digital demand generation and customer journey activation across markets.

• Turn data and analytics into actionable recommendations, and use automation and AI to improve relevance, targeting, effectiveness and productivity.

• Develop web, digital experience and performance management excellence, including how we measure commercial contribution and return on marketing investment.

• Build scalable global frameworks that enable markets to execute effectively while responding to local commercial needs.

Partner closely across Global Marketing, Sales and markets to make digital an integrated part of commercial execution.

What we are looking for

You are a Senior Digital Marketing Leader who combines strategic thinking, commercial understanding and strong execution.

We expect you to bring:

• 10+ years of experience in digital marketing, including several years in a senior leadership role.

• Solid experience from an international B2B or B2B2C organization with complex customer journeys, multiple markets and a global/local operating model.

• Proven experience leading sizeable teams and, ideally, leaders across areas such as demand generation, marketing automation, digital activation, web, performance marketing or marketing technology.

• A proven track record of creating measurable commercial impact through digital marketing.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work across Marketing, Sales, technology and markets.

• An analytical, data-driven mindset and curiosity about emerging technologies and AI.

As a leader

You create clarity in complex environments, foster trust through openness and transparency, and build strong teams while developing talent.

You are comfortable operating at senior level, simplifying complexity and balancing customer needs, brand ambitions and commercial priorities.

Why join us?

You will join the Global Marketing Leadership team, reporting to the Senior Vice President of Global Marketing, at an exciting time as we continue to build a strong commercial organization with end-to-end accountabilities and close collaboration across functions and markets.

You will play a key role in strengthening the digital capabilities that are increasingly critical to driving growth and engaging customers.

Besides the professional part, you can also look forward to:

• Work-life balance.

• Flexible pension plan.

• Healthy canteen, fruit, coffee and tea.

• Fitness facilities and classes.

• Massage scheme.

• Working from home furniture.

• Employee clubs and networks.

Interested in our exciting position? - Deadline is the 2nd of November 2026.

Submit CV and a short, focused motivation in English reflecting the profile above.

We expect to hold the 1st interview on Monday the 11th and Wednesday the 13th of November and the 2nd interview on the 25th, 26th and 27th of November.

Applications are only accepted via our online platform. We do not respond to inquiries from external suppliers.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.

At Demant, we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I), and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality. #LI-HYBRID#LI-BS1

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions, and expertise to help people hear better. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries where we create life-changing hearing health and high-end audio and video solutions. William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and among the 25 most traded stocks.

**About GoWish, Ønskeskyen ☁️

**At GoWish, we’re building the world’s leading wish-list and social shopping platform - a place where you can make a real impact and have fun doing it.

We’re on a mission to reinvent gifting for millions. We win together, driven by curiosity, ownership, and bold ideas that turn into real products. We experiment cross-functionally, push for excellence, and keep things playful as we grow - together.

**Team & Role Overview

**We are looking for a systems-minded Senior ML Data Engineer to own the offline-to-online feature infrastructure that powers our real-time recommendation and search engines at scale. You will be building the low-latency data syncs and feature-serving layers that bridge our analytical warehouses with operational databases, caches, and Feature Stores. This is a role for a performance-driven engineer who excels at pipeline orchestration (Airflow, dbt), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Docker), and database tuning, ensuring our recommendation systems receive reliable data under strict low-latency SLAs. If you thrive on solving complex data synchronization challenges, scaling operational storage for millions of users, and acting as the operational bridge between Data Science and Backend Engineering - you will play a critical role in powering our product's core ML capabilities.

**What You'll Do

**

• Offline-to-Online Feature Pipelines: Build and operate resilient feature pipelines syncing transformed data from analytical warehouses (e.g., BigQuery) into operational storage layers (e.g., AlloyDB, Redis, Feature Stores) to serve real-time ML recommendation models at scale.

• Pipeline Orchestration and Transformations: Design, test, and maintain robust Apache Airflow DAGs and modular dbt transformations to automate end-to-end data ingestion and feature generation under strict low-latency SLAs.

• Infrastructure as Code and Reliability: Provision, scale, and automate cloud data infrastructure using Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines, implementing automated data quality testing and monitoring across all feature syncs.

• Cross-Functional System Design: Partner directly with Data Scientists and Backend Engineers to define online/offline feature contracts, optimize database schemas for sub-second queries, and eliminate training-serving skew for millions of active users.

**What we’re looking for 🌟

****We Imagine That You Have

**

• 4+ years of experience

• Operational Data Pipelines: Proven experience moving batch features from analytical warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake) into low-latency online stores (AlloyDB, Redis, Feature Stores) to serve real-time ML recommendation models.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Deep hands-on experience provisioning, scaling, and managing cloud data infrastructure using Terraform, Docker, and modern CI/CD automation pipelines.

• Pipeline Orchestration & Transformations: Strong track record building, scheduling, and maintaining workflow orchestrations (e.g., Airflow, Dagster) and modular data transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt).

• Database Performance Tuning: Advanced SQL skills across both OLAP and OLTP systems. Ability to optimize schemas, indexing, partitioning, and queries.

It is further seen as an advantage to have experience with:

• Production Feature Management: Experience managing Feature Stores (e.g., Feast, Tecton) or low-latency key-value stores (e.g., Redis) to serve online ML features with zero training-serving skew.

• Real-Time OLA): Experience with ClickHouse, Pinot, Druid or others for ultra-fast aggregations over live event streams.

• Event Streaming: Hands-on experience with streaming tools like GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, or Flink for real-time feature updates.

Why GoWish should sit at top of your career wish list 💙

At GoWish, we believe great work comes from people who feel energized, supported, and excited to show up every day. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where celebration, growth, and genuine enjoyment are part of the journey - not perks on the side.

Take your birthday off with Happy Birthday Leave, enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully recharge, and join a team that fills the year with events and playful happenings. We invest in your future with pension and insurance, fuel your days with a weekly lunch scheme, and keep you going with unlimited snacks and sodas - because work should feel good.

At GoWish, you don’t just build great products. You build a great work life.

**Practical information

**We collaborate in a flexible hybrid setup, with most of our magic happening at our bright, modern office in Østerbro - perfectly placed between Nordhavn and Østerport Station. We’re ready for you to join us as soon as you are.

👉 Ready to help shape a platform that already empowers 18+ million users (and counting)? Join us at GoWish - and let’s build the future of data-driven innovation together.

Don’t wait to apply - we review applications continuously and may close the position once the right candidate is found.

**About The Role

**In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to senior leadership, helping shape commercial decisions through data-driven insights and recommendations. You will lead and develop a high-performing analytics team while driving the evolution of Pandora's Revenue Growth Management capabilities through advanced analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. The role also involves building strong cross-functional relationships and influencing stakeholders through structured problem-solving, compelling communication, and fact-based recommendations.

**More Specifically, Key Accountabilities Will Include

**

• Lead strategic and operational Revenue Growth Management (RGM) initiatives end-to-end, from problem definition and stakeholder alignment through analysis, recommendation development, implementation, and measurable business impact.

• Proactively identify growth opportunities and commercial insights, translating complex and large-scale datasets into clear hypotheses, actionable recommendations, and leadership-ready narratives.

• Shape and advance Pandora's RGM capabilities by leveraging advanced analytics, automation, AI-enabled tools, and competitor intelligence to deliver strategic and tactical recommendations that support revenue growth.

• Own and continuously enhance RGM ways of working, driving consistency, scalable best practices, and capability development across markets and teams.

• Serve as the analytical backbone for Pricing and Promotions, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities and improve overall RGM performance.

• Support the implementation and evolution of future RGM processes, tools, systems, and external partnerships, including vendor evaluation and capability assessment.

• Collaborate closely with Data & Analytics teams to strengthen data quality, infrastructure, automation, and scalability, enabling more effective and sustainable decision-making.

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**You're able to prioritize and set direction to cut through complexity in changing and fast-paced environments. You build strong relationships with a varietyof stakeholders, including senior leadership. You are a strong communicator, with the ability to facilitate meetings and decision-making for multiple stakeholders independently.

**Additionally, We Hope That You Have And Can Demonstrate

**

• Around 6-8 years of experience from strong similar unit (e.g. RGM or Pricing), finance, or management consulting role

• Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot), with the ability to combine traditional analytical techniques, modelling, and AI-assisted insights to support business decision-making

• Experience with Alteryx or comparable data engineering, ETL, and analytics platforms to enable scalable analysis of large transactional datasets, with familiarity in automation and AI-driven workflows.

• Strong problem solving and project management skills able to drive complex projects.

• Passion about Revenue Management with strong track record from similar roles

• Excellent strategic mindset and commercial instinct

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our Head Office in Copenhagen V. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Job Description

Turn sales strategies into real action and make changes happen. If you enjoy implementing new sales processes and best practices, you should definitely read on!

The role you’ll play

As our Sales Operations Manager, you’ll focus on implementing changes across our Sales organisation and ensuring that new initiatives are adopted in practice. We have new ideas and visions in abundance; however, we need your experience and drive to fulfil their potential and ensure the changes become part of our everyday ways of working.

You’ll work on initiatives that support our Business Development (BD) and Account Management (AM) teams, helping us improve the adoption of sales methodologies, standardise sales presentations, introduce new products and services, and establish a common training baseline.

The team you'll be a part of

You will be part of our Sales Operations team with 3 other colleagues, and part of the wider Sales Excellence Department, which also consists of Solution Sales (expert pre-sales) and Onboarding (expert post-sales). Shared across the three teams is a deep interest for both our industry, best practice sales methodology, and how we can do more with AI.

If you want to make a difference, make it with us by…

• Ensure we keep having transparent and clear sales methodologies, even with a constantly changing environment of new product launches and AI-tools

• Further improve sales performance and sales analytics via. leveraging HubSpot features

• Drive the implementation and adoption of new ways of working – for example an AI-tool for RFP completion, updated sales presentation, or demos of our new products

• Be both inspiring and firm with your colleagues – change can be hard, and we are both supporting and demanding of our colleagues

In one year, you’ll know you were successful if…

• Our sales colleagues clearly know when and how to use which processes and tools to sell

• We can quickly and efficiently launch new products and services

• You are recognised as a sales process expert by your colleagues

Desired experience and competencies

What does it take to work for LanguageWire?

What you'll need to bring

• 3+ years of experience in a similar role in Sales, Commercial management, Consulting or similar

• Demonstrated track record of driving change programs

• Strong analytical mindset to analyse sales performance data and recommend actionable improvements.

• Even stronger emotional intelligence, as change requires convincing both hearts and minds

• A genuine interest in our industry – we believe we need to care about something to sell it

This will make you stand out

• Master’s degree in business, economics, or a related field

• Similar experience in a scale-up environment

• Impressive examples of impact

• Genuine interest for LanguageWire

Your colleagues say you are

• A pro-active, diligent and trustworthy colleague – you will get a lot of freedom to design the change programs.

• An inspiring communicator – we need someone who can also sell the vision of change

• An open, brave, and kind extrovert – you should not be afraid of calling 10 colleagues to hear why they are not (yet) doing the change

Our perks

• Enjoy flat hierarchies, responsibility and freedom, direct feedback, and room to stand up for your own ideas

• Internal development opportunities, ongoing support from your People Partner, and an inclusive and fun company culture

• International company with over 300 employees. Offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Varberg, London, Leuven, Lille, Paris, Munich, Hamburg, Sophia Antipolis, Atlanta, Helsinki, Turku and Valencia

• We have a hybrid work model called FlexiWire. We offer weekly flexibility, working three days in the office and two days from home. Together with your team, you can coordinate which days to collaborate in the office.

• We take care of our people and initiate many social get-togethers, from Friday Bars to Summer or Christmas parties. We have fun!

Aarhus

• 18 great colleagues the Aarhus office belonging to different business departments

• A lovely office in the city center with great colleagues and a very friendly and helpful atmosphere

• A wonderful terrace so you can enjoy your lunch outdoors, and it also makes for a great venue for summer parties

• Also, epic quizzes and games at parties, and legendary drinks (we have the best bartenders)

Copenhagen

• 34 great colleagues in the Copenhagen office belonging to different business departments

• Open office space with large windows, bringing a light and chill atmosphere for informal chats with colleagues

• Catered lunches every day

• The comfiest couches you will ever sit on

• Monthly Town Hall events broadcast from the office

• Conveniently located close to multiple public transportation options, with private parking available for those who drive to work

About LanguageWire

At LanguageWire, we want to wire the world together with language. Why? Because we want to help people & businesses simplify communication. We are fueled by the most advanced technology (AI) and our goal is to make customers' lives easier by simplifying their communication with any audience across the globe.

Our values drive our behaviour

We are curious. We are trustworthy. We are caring. We are ambitious.

At LanguageWire, we are curious and intrigued by what we don’t understand. We believe relationships are based on honesty and responsibility, and being trustworthy reinforces an open, humble, and honest way of communicating. We are caring and respect each other personally and professionally. We encourage authentic collaboration, invite feedback and a positive social environment. Our desire to learn, build, and share knowledge is a natural part of our corporate culture.

Working at LanguageWire — why we like it:

“At LanguageWire, we use our years of expert experience and knowledge that we've built up in the language industry to share best practices with our customers. We show that we can be a trusted and caring partner by helping our customers to constantly improve their processes by recommending various solutions. In doing so, we can celebrate their successes together”.

(Anna-Karin, Business Development Director, Varberg)

Yes, to diversity, equity & inclusion

In LanguageWire, we believe diversity in gender, age, background, and culture is essential for our growth. Therefore, we are committed to creating a culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and expertise in our everyday work.

LanguageWire’s recruitment process is designed to be transparent and fair for all candidates. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply, and we ensure that candidates are provided with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their competencies and skills.

Want to know more?

We can’t wait to meet you! So, why wait 'til tomorrow? Apply today!

If you want to know more about LanguageWire, we encourage you to visit our website!

The Senior AI Adoption Lead takes ownership of ALK's continuous AI adoption programme, turning enthusiasm into real, safe, everyday value from the AI tools available to ALK employees. This role continues the adoption efforts from 2025 (over 1,000 employees trained in GenAI usage) and 2026 (more tailored training on ALK's AI solutions) and is key to achieving ALK's AI ambition within the Allergy+ strategy.

This role requires genuine enthusiasm for enabling people, facilitating great learning experiences, and driving change. The Senior AI Adoption Lead must work closely with people across all business areas, be proactive, reach out to employees, and drive AI adoption across the entire organization so that the change is permanent and sticks with employees.

This role owns ALK's continuous AI adoption programme, covering general enablement on GenAI, tailored upskilling for all employees, and engagement activities that drive adoption. This includes preparing and hosting AI training (both general-purpose and tool-specific), the training calendar, micro-learning, maintaining AI at ALK intranet site. The role also owns measuring GenAI usage across the organization, providing the data needed to support informed decisions in AI strategy implementation.

This is not an engineering role – the person does not need to build or configure AI solutions. It does, however, require basic understanding of both business and IT, so the Senior AI Adoption Lead can act as an effective bridge between the two. Genuine enthusiasm for new technologies, especially generative AI, is required. Experience with usage of those technologies in daily life and enterprise scenario is vital.

The Senior AI Adoption Lead acts as a proxy between business and IT: translating technical concepts into everyday business language, aligning business demand with IT delivery, triaging common issues, and accelerating adoption before escalation to IT.

This role is based in Denmark, where ALK has its headquarters and the majority of AI users. It also requires occasional business travel to conduct in-person workshops and training.

• 
Communicate the need for AI adoption through meetings, newsletters, MS Teams, and Intranet; share success stories, best practices, and enthusiasm for upcoming initiatives.

Foster engagement through targeted workshops for departments and business units, regular manager briefings, tailored communications, and a visible emphasis on the benefits of AI in daily work.

•

Work side by side with the technical teams (programmers, architects, data and platform specialists): take part in solution and roadmap discussions, learn how the solutions work, ask questions from the end-user perspective, challenge and advise on usability, and translate the outcome into layman terms for the business.

About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

As Financial Analyst, you'll own the day-to-day financial planning and analysis (FP&A) across clinical programmes, research and corporate functions. You'll turn financial data and input from colleagues into reliable forecasts, useful insights and clear reporting that helps Hemab make informed decisions.

Working closely with the FP&A Director, you'll take ownership of recurring financial activities while helping build practical ways of working as Hemab grows. Your work will give our teams greater financial clarity and help us make thoughtful decisions about the resources behind our science.

What you'll do

• Own monthly FP&A activities across assigned clinical studies, research projects and functions, keeping forecasts accurate and up to date.

• Partner with functional leads and project teams to understand spending, challenge assumptions and identify financial risks and opportunities early.

• Coordinate quarterly forecasts and contribute to the annual Investment Plan and Long-Range Plan.

• Analyse actuals against forecasts, explain variances and turn financial information into clear, useful insights.

• Prepare management reporting, financial commentary and decision materials for review by the FP&A Director.

• Maintain and improve Power BI reporting, ensuring reliable data and consistent financial information.

• Manage routine financial follow-up with CROs and vendors, including invoice reviews, change orders and financial input to negotiations.

• Build straightforward financial frameworks and reporting practices that help teams work efficiently as Hemab grows.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Experience in FP&A, forecasting, management reporting and financial business partnering.

• Strong financial analysis skills, with the ability to turn complex information into practical recommendations.

• Advanced Excel skills and hands-on experience with Power BI.

• Experience managing forecasts independently, identifying material changes and knowing when to escalate.

• Ability to work effectively with finance and non-finance colleagues, communicate clearly and challenge assumptions constructively.

• Professional fluency in English.

Nice to have

• Experience in biotech, pharma, clinical development, CROs or another project-driven environment.

• Familiarity with clinical study budgets, vendor financial management or financial planning systems.

• Experience improving financial reporting or building ways of working in a growing organisation.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. Whoever takes this role will likely build some of their own process instead of inheriting a finished one. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

We value people who take ownership, solve problems, ask for help when needed and work without ego. At our size, how you work matters as much as your CV. Good structure should help people move faster and trust the numbers, not slow them down.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

About the job

We are looking for a motivated and structured student assistant who wants to learn how crisis readiness is built in practice. You will support both the day-to-day maintenance of our Crisis Management framework and the continued development of the Crisis Management Team. The role combines practical coordination, document and data management, analysis, communication and continuous improvement work.

You will receive clear priorities and guidance, but you will also be trusted to be responsible for defined tasks and follow them through. Your work will contribute directly to making plans easier to use, training more effective, and improvement actions more visible.

Purpose of the role

Your purpose is to help keep our crisis-management setup current, organised and ready for use. You will support documents, exercises, readiness activities, reporting and follow-up, while learning how operational resilience and executive crisis management work in a large infrastructure company.

Key responsibilities

• Maintain and improve crisis plans, appendices, role descriptions, quick guides, checklists and templates.

By Malene Birger is currently looking for a Wholesale Account Executive for

the Danish market.

Key responsibilities

As Wholesale Account Executive for the DK region (Denmark incl. Faroe Island, Greenland and Iceland) you will be

essential at accelerating the brand’s growth within your designated territories. Reporting directly to the Danish

headquarters and the Commercial Director based in Copenhagen, you will develop strategic initiatives, nurture key

partnerships, and act as a passionate brand ambassador. We expect you to be based out of Denmark, conscious

that regular travel in your designated markets will be essential to foster relationships, monitor market dynamics,

and showcase collections in your market. Travel should be expected 3/5 days a week, with majority of the travel

executed across the Danish region, with 1-2 visits per year in the areas outside of Denmark.

It is required that the candidate holds a valid driver’s license.

This is a dynamic and rewarding role, requiring a flexible and agile lifestyle, operational abilities, and exceptional

relationship management, perfect for a mid-level candidate ready to take on further responsibilities.

Market Development & Sales Planning

positioning and long-term growth objectives aligned with Danish HQ growth strategies.

market share expansion, and achievement of key performance indicators.

ongoing development.

your markets.

and communicating the brand’s values and aesthetic.

Copenhagen and Paris.

Operational Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment

commercial, branding, and operational objectives and company policies.

marketing initiatives to maintain relevance and drive desirability.

• Oversee the management and advancement of the sales pipeline and forecasting tools, ensuring accurate

tracking of performance and future planning.

Product Training & Service Excellence

• Support and guide sales teams and partners through product training and brand education to maximize

sales impact.

• Ensure consistent, high-quality customer experience in all wholesale interactions, fostering loyalty and

brand advocacy across any touch point with the brand.

Professional

• 2-3 years of experience within wholesale, B2B sales, and/or account management within the fashion,

interior or luxury industry.

• Successful experience with executing sales strategies, managing sales budgets, and reaching targets.

• Good understanding of market dynamics, industry trends, and consumer insights to inform strategic

decisions.

plus.

• Flair for analytical, preferably with proficiency in sales reporting tools, CRM platforms, and Microsoft

Office, especially Excel.

• Outgoing, and relationship-centric personality, with authentic interpersonal and communication skills.

dedicated team across different cultures and environments.

relationships.

SmallClaims – turning unpaid invoices into won court cases Every year, European businesses write off billions in valid, winnable claims. Not because they would lose in court, but because pursuing a €3,000 invoice with lawyers and court fees costs more than the claim is worth. The court system was built for a time when a lawyer handled every case. That works for a €1M dispute. It does not work for a 15,000 DKK invoice. SmallClaims fixes that. We are a Copenhagen-based legal tech company that recovers small, valid claims of up to €25,000 through the courts. Our AI agents run the whole process, from legal assessment and settlement to filing, judgment and enforcement, while our in-house lawyers quality-assure the work and appear in court when needed. Today we have handled 5,000+ cases, win 90%+ of our court cases and serve 500+ customers in Denmark, from businesses with many outstanding invoices to debt collection agencies and law firms. Case intake has grown more than 370% since 2023. In 2026 we raised a €2M seed round led by Vendep Capital to expand into more European markets. We are a small team of lawyers who build and engineers who litigate. If you want real ownership from day one and to help build the engine that gives every business access to justice, no matter the size of the claim, we would like to hear from you.
